title: ConfigSet
description: QoS 1 on agri/v1/{robot_id}/config/set. Versioned: the robot echoes the version back on config/ack, and the UI shows the change as pending until it does. Versions are assigned by the backend and stored in robot_config_versions, so the full history of who changed what is recoverable.

detection_sensitivity.description: Higher flags more plants and produces more false positives. The UI states that in plain language rather than showing a bare number.

issued_by.description: User id of the operator. Written to audit_log with the command; every command is attributable to a person.

lease_id.description: Control lease held by that operator. The backend rejects a command whose lease has expired or is held by someone else.
